
- Consent granularity: one yes/no for the non-baseline set, or per name once catalogs grow.
- Staleness: whether to force re-materialization after N days for long-lived worktrees.
- Catalog visibility: the full catalog is served to any authenticated actor; whether to narrow per role or project.
- Catalog home: whether to promote the 1Password item to a backbone table plus admin CLI if churn grows.
